Subject: Need help with a geographical-indication dispute case

Hello, my name is Swati Kamath. I am a 26-year-old cardiologist living in Pune. Our producers' association has a geographical-indication dispute with Crescent Exports over sales of INR 6,55,00,000/-, and the rival product uses the protected regional name on its label. My case number is CS(COMM) 120/2024 in the Bombay High Court. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on +91 82078 30175 or email swati.kamath94@example.com.
